name: AP_DISCOUNT_NOTIFICATIONS
description: This table contains information about the discount offer notifications sent to the supplier and the action taken by the supplier.

columns.name: OFFER_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the discount offer associated with a supplier site assignment.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Notification reference identifier. This helps identify the invoices that the action must update.

columns.name: VENDOR_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Supplier contact who receives the notifications.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the supplier contact.

columns.name: SEND_DATE
columns.description: Date when the offer notification was sent.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action taken by the supplier on the offer. Possible values are ACCEPT, REJECT, UNSUBSCRIBE, and STANDING_OFFER.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments entered by the supplier for the notification.

columns.name: RESPONSE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the supplier acted on the offer.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
